profile_text.body:
Meta's developer site describes the company as a provider of AI models and tools for developers, with access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The company says Muse Spark is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The site also describes a quick start that points an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and search grounding that gives a model live access to the web by adding a single tool to a request. Muse Image is described as available on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image, a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits.

Meta is a public company, ticker META, CIK 0001326801, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA. Its most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting $200,966,000,000. The product tracked for Meta is Llama (Meta), described as an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted.

Three lawsuits are recorded against Meta Platforms: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. California is recorded as a jurisdiction with 281 cases. MCP servers associated with Meta include ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as a Meta Ads server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights; co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp for Facebook and Meta Ads automation; and com.adbloop/meta-ads for bulk creation of Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders.
